License evidence
The creator's OpenGameArt upload identifies bevouliin.com as the author and explicitly lists CC0 under License(s), linked to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.
The downloaded archive contains a creator note but no standalone license file. This record preserves the source-page declaration; it is not represented as an original bundled license.

Imported files
Transparent PNG/frame-1.png through frame-8.png, stored here as frame-1.png through frame-8.png.
bevouliin.com.txt.txt, retained unchanged as the original creator note.
All imported PNG bytes are unchanged. Unity imports them as sprites; PlayerFeedback selects the eight frames for animation and applies visual transforms.
GIF-preview.gif is reference-only outside Assets and is not imported.
